$comment: Spec execution registry for this package. Every spec file under the spec directory appears here exactly once. A spec that does not run by default must record why, which environment variables gate it, and which job covers it. tests/spec-registry.spec.ts fails when this file and the tests directory disagree, so a spec cannot be skipped without a recorded reason and a named owner.

modes.default: Runs under `pnpm exec vitest run packages/bundle/riko-memory` with no environment setup. No test inside may be skipped, todo or conditional.
modes.opt-in: Does not run in the default suite. It needs external configuration, so it must name the environment variables that gate it and the job that covers it.

coverageOwnerForms.none: No job covers it. acceptedGap must be true, and neither the README nor memory-v3-progress.md may claim the behaviour as verified.
coverageOwnerForms.manual:<slug>: A documented operator procedure covers it. The slug names the procedure; it is not a CI job.
coverageOwnerForms.ci-<mode>: A run-gates mode covers it. The mode must exist in scripts/run-gates.ts.

companion-campaign.spec.ts.reason: It drives the 30-scenario Appendix F corpus against the operator's real Dream and final-answer providers. Continuous integration has no such provider, and every recorded metric is provider-dependent, so the file skips before corpus setup instead of measuring a stand-in.

dense-ablation-real.spec.ts.reason: It measures dense recall over the Appendix F corpus through a real embedding endpoint. The keyless deterministic provider reports dense noise 60 of 60 on the same corpus where a real model reports 2 of 10, so a run without DSH_MEMORY_BGE_ENDPOINT measures the stand-in rather than the capability.

dense-semantic-gain.spec.ts.reason: It measures unique semantic gain on the paraphrase corpus through a real embedding endpoint. Lexical overlap is the negative control and the deterministic provider scores 2 of 5, so the spec is meaningless without DSH_MEMORY_BGE_ENDPOINT.

empirical-decision-campaign.spec.ts.reason: It measures real Gemini embedding latency, exercises bounded remote-provider faults, and records the F.29 one-to-two-hop graph decision. The campaign needs the operator's Gemini credential and is not a default or CI run.

observed.$comment: Recorded measurements, kept for comparison. tests/spec-registry.spec.ts checks the detailed docs/spec-execution-report.json against discovered specs and requirement candidates; these totals include the registry gate itself. The repository rejects commit identifiers in maintained files, so this record is anchored by date and package version; the platform that ran it holds the revision.
